name: Uğur Böceği
notes: Small opening-level design. Visually counted 16 closed panes: 6 subject panes (one connected red wing shell, one continuous plum head/central tongue, four plum spots) and 10 alternating blue/green background sectors. Rounded central tongue leaves a broad connected red band underneath. Checked after one regeneration: closed boundaries, separated T junctions, no visible X crossings or tiny filler panes; subject/background colour pairs remain separate. Opaque white exterior. Remaining doubt: subtle tonal shading persists despite flat-fill instructions; palette values are intended tracing colours. Design sheet only; no geometry or catalogue changes.
